scientific_limitations: Symmetric two-map affine Cantor IFS with 0<r<1/2 and uniform target. Only the fair-weight objective is computed exactly; for biased weights the displayed bound may be strict. title: Sharp IID-shaping gap and unattainable support projection for two-map Cantor systems
